io_cuts.authority: Source-netlist logical canonical net bits, not placed package pins or achieved pinmux ratio
io_cuts.per_fpga_definition: Unique outgoing data/control net bits plus unique incoming data/control net bits; one multicast source counted once
io_cuts.matrix_definition: One canonical data/control net bit per directed source/destination FPGA pair

quality.minimum_link_hop_scope: declared selected topology shortest links; lower bound, not actual routed transport
quality.path_model: primitive conservative data arcs; top IO has no FPGA home
quality.swap_limits: 64 vertices,16 feasible partners,4096 probes,8000000 total scan units,65536 indices per neighborhood,4 swaps per pass
quality.timing_sample_coverage: exported sampled native setup paths only; not all-path STA
quality.timing_scope: internal owner crossings only; no FPGA homes invented for top IO
quality.timing_cost_normalization: fixed maximum source criticality; scale1 if all source criticalities zero

cost_policy.route_guarantee: One extra link outweighs secondary penalties on any simple route or Steiner tree with at most k-1 links
cost_policy.scope: Scalar native objective across all nets; not a global lexicographic guarantee, measured latency, or hard routed link capacity

source_document.note: vertex = physical FPGA, edge = pair is physically connected, weight = lane count. Absent pair = NOT connected: traffic between it must relay through a third FPGA, costing an extra DUT_CLK cycle and a full socket delay.

topology.wires_semantics: Declared minimum-compression metadata preserved and arithmetic checked; not assumed to be raw pins, achievable per-cycle capacity, a TDM ratio or measured latency

historical_evidence.scope: Historical source-netlist resource and connectivity measurements preserved by checked exact functional ownership and top-port owner equivalence; no new Vivado, regroup, wrapper or hardware validation

run_settings.native_timeout_scope: persistent checkpoint startup and each resource request; batch commands unaffected

source_pair_association.export_run_association: Supplied PASS manifest asserts one export association; producer command, actual native exit0 and completion are not verified
source_pair_association.scope: Exact payload and receipt-byte consistency; no arbitrary EDIF/checkpoint electrical-equivalence or cryptographic-authenticity proof

run_settings.native_residency_policy: Probe after Java; retain only when measured available RAM covers the next heap, 8 GiB overhead and a prior-HGR native solver reserve
run_settings.selection_policy: Hard capacities and one cut/topology budget; complete paths; worst minimum-link hop lower bound, logical register-free crossings, sampled source timing cost, endpoint excess, transit; native search-envelope limitation tier, transfers, topology cost, then fine balance; preferred balance remains soft
run_settings.minimum_link_hop_scope: Declared selected adjacency shortest-link lower bounds; not actual transport routing, congestion or nanoseconds
run_settings.scope: Original synthesized netlist subset utilization; no future wrapper/transport resources included
run_settings.historical_metrics_scope: Original native and source-graph measurements preserved by exact ownership equivalence; not rerun

run_provenance.minimum_link_hop_scope: Lower bounds on declared selected adjacency; not actual transport routing, congestion or nanoseconds
run_provenance.timing_net_identity_scope: Cell-pair guidance applies to all parallel matching hyperedges; not exact pin-arc identification
run_provenance.physical_utilization_authority: Native Vivado subset report required separately
run_provenance.useful_logic_definition: Sum of HardwarePartitionGraph.realLogic over final frontier assignments; excludes trusted constant/clock/I/O infrastructure and synthetic capture endpoints; not LUT count or packed area
run_provenance.timing_edge_weights: 1+round(weight*max source owner-pair criticality/max sampled source criticality), increment capped at 1000000

deviation_definition: 100*(per-FPGA value/arithmetic mean - 1); all-zero values have 0% deviation
scope: Selected source-netlist mapping only; no downstream regroup, package-pin allocation, implemented timing or hardware claim
